workflow_runs.name: rust-ci
workflow_runs.display_title: Add turn-scoped ephemeral context

head_commit.message:
Clarify ephemeral context docs and restore replayed pending input

Rewrite the ephemeralContext field description to explain that it applies
only to the current turn and should be resent as a fresh snapshot on later
turns. While validating the change, fix the current tui replay path so
pending steers are preserved in thread snapshots and restored as queued
follow-ups.

Tests:
- cargo test -p codex-app-server-protocol
- cargo test -p codex-tui

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
